paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is currently 6.28, representing a decrease of 13.14% from the prior close and 33.54% over the past 21 trading sessions.

Recent news headlines include reports on the development of Project Matador, a 17-gigawatt private power and AI campus being built in Texas, as well as the company's executive team appointments and a completed convertible senior notes offering.

There have been several recent SEC filings, including the appointment of new officers, the resignation of director Miles Everson, and the issuance of $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031. There has been one Form 4 filing and no Form 144 filings.
